scope.method: FFmpeg extraction from completed final.mp4 files, followed by direct assistant inspection with view_image.
scope.selection: One guided-repeat frame and one waiting/reveal pair per episode. A appears in ep01/ep25, B in ep12/ep36, and C in ep24/ep48.
scope.timing_basis: Resolved scene start, demo_start, demo_end and reveal_at values; waiting samples fall inside the response interval.
scope.caption_assessment: The reserved lower 90 pixels were inspected. Optional CC overlays were not rendered into these PNG samples.

criteria: Embedded English is legible and complete, including descenders, punctuation and guided word backgrounds.
The waiting snapshot leaves all options neutral; the later snapshot highlights the correct option and prints the answer.
Course branding and season/stage headers match the source.
Learning text and artwork remain above the reserved optional-CC area.
source_binding: Some samples were extracted while only a frozen season was available. Every sampled authored episode and its resolved counterpart were revalidated against the final merged source for this report.
